# Marcus Fogg

> Director of Marketing at Rocket SaaS, a B2B SaaS marketing agency in London.
> Demand generation, positioning and event programmes for B2B SaaS clients.

Marcus Fogg leads a team of Account Directors at Rocket SaaS across a portfolio
of B2B SaaS clients. He has spent ten years in B2B marketing across the UK,
Europe and Australia, in-house and agency-side. Most of that work has been
demand generation: positioning first, then the campaigns, content and events
that bring buyers in. He also runs the agency's own in-person event programme.

Before Rocket SaaS he was Senior Marketing Manager at &us in London (2023 to
2025) and spent 2019 to 2023 at Famly in Copenhagen, joining as Digital
Marketing Coordinator and leaving as Senior Marketing Project Manager. Earlier
roles were at MAN Diesel & Turbo in Copenhagen and Reload Media in Brisbane.

## Selected work

All of it delivered at Rocket SaaS with the agency's specialists and the
clients' own marketing teams.

- **Crown Workforce Management** (crownworkforcemanagement.com): workforce
  management software for large healthcare, manufacturing and public sector
  employers. Sector messaging sharpened, 42 pages of the site redesigned and
  rewritten with refreshed product visuals, and a LinkedIn funnel aimed at
  their actual buyers. 7x more leads per month, 97% lower cost per LinkedIn
  lead, a £140k first-year enterprise deal.
- **Startle** (startle.io): background music, digital signage and platform
  management for multi-site retail and hospitality. Google Ads split by
  vertical, enterprise messaging overhauled, campaigns run off their own
  research. 430 leads in nine months, 50% lower Google Ads cost per lead,
  average won deal value up 16.1%.
- **Homeflow** (homeflow.co.uk): websites and software for UK estate agents.
  Attribution fixed first, then free valuations and AI website assessments put
  at the front of the Meta campaigns. 483 MQLs in 16 months.
- **StoreFeeder** (storefeeder.com): warehouse and multichannel e-commerce
  software. Pitch moved onto overselling and picking errors, Google Ads
  reworked, and a route added for buyers not ready for a demo. 62% more deals
  closed won.
- **Ami** (meetami.ai): AI agents that guide visitors through a website. Pitch
  led on the revenue a site loses, with a free site audit used to reach bigger
  brands. 3x organic and direct leads.

## In-house: the breakfast series

Rocket SaaS runs a demand generation breakfast for SaaS founders and marketing
leaders. Marcus built the programme end to end: venue, guest list, promotion
across paid and organic, the reminder sequence, and the Asana template the team
runs each event from. The founder and strategy team present on the day. It has
moved from one event a quarter towards one a month. Events source 15% of the
agency's qualified deals, worth around £1.5m ARR.

## How he works

- Positioning and demand generation: working out what a product is for and who
  it is for, before spending anything on reaching them.
- Teams and client experience: leading Account Directors and the specialists
  who deliver the work.
- Full-funnel campaigns: paid media, content, website and lifecycle, measured
  on pipeline rather than on traffic.
- Event programmes: built from concept through promotion, delivery and
  follow-up.
